# Ñāṇavibhaṅga (Vb 16)

**ID:** Vb 16
**Section:** Vibhaṅga (vb)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Ñāṇavibhaṅga
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh02m.mul15.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Ñāṇavibhaṅga* ("Analysis of Knowledge") constitutes the sixteenth chapter of the *Vibhaṅga*, the second book of the Theravāda *Abhidhamma Piṭaka* [Endo 1997; von Hinüber 1996]. The treatise provides a systematic categorization and analytical exposition of knowledge (*ñāṇa*), arranged methodically according to an ascending numerical principle akin to that of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* [von Hinüber 1996]. Within its classification of knowledge, it elaborates in detail upon doctrinal sets such as the ten powers of a Tathāgata (*dasatathāgatabala*) [Endo 1997].
